## Site Classification and Data Correlation

- Adam and Gen completed assigning project classification concepts across all pedons from 2024 and deep pedons (greater than 100 cm depth) from 2025.
- Approximately 20 shallow pedons from 2025 remain unclassified due to limited depth profile data.
- Adam will identify representative central concept pedons and evaluate which samples require additional laboratory analysis to establish efficient lab testing workflows.
- For pedons with missing laboratory particle size or soil texture data (predominantly from early 2024), Adam will assign field estimate classes based on geomorphic location, soil survey descriptions, and neighboring pedon trends rather than leaving fields blank, following Joe's suggestion.
- Laser particle size analysis (LPSA) conducted in the lab provides relative profile differentiation and clustering data rather than absolute hydrometer-equivalent texture classes.
- Primary geomorphic breaks for till were split into medium/fine-textured till and medium/coarse-textured till based on observed soil properties.
- Joseph recommended refining the project's overall geomorphic surface map at a 1:12,000 scale over the next month or two, incorporating point-level field findings and existing soil survey data before feeding the updated boundaries into spatial modeling pipelines.
